The encoder retains original JSON residual data and declared group lists. Per-table union labels plus a separate int32 order matrix retain present-zero versus absent keys and each original map order; nested normal/closure and 2000-repeat cases are covered.
Counts must be exact Python integers in uint32 range; booleans, floats, negatives, overflow and invalid group identities are rejected before narrowing.

Summed logical cells are checked before each table matrix allocation; the decoder checks table/array identities, dtypes/shapes, paths, duplicate row/group/order metadata, padding and nonzero values in absent columns.

The component writes no files and invokes no statistics. The source traversal and decoder deepcopy/read-only array access do not mutate inputs in the ordinary JSON/ndarray domain; encode non-mutation is explicitly tested.

Important.title: Decoder accepts incomplete table coverage and silently replaces scientific counts with None
Important.problem: Residual count placeholders are validated only when a table mentions them. No final traversal verifies that every recognized count placeholder has been restored. A self-consistent deletion of a table and its arrays, or row_indices and matching array rows, passes the current structural validation.
Important.impact: decode_counts can successfully return group_draw_counts:null instead of an exact count map. This is decoded scientific-data loss, independent of future bundle I/O or resource qualification, and violates fail-closed lossless decoding.
Important.reproduction: Encode literal {draws:[{group_draw_counts:{a:2}},{group_draw_counts:{b:3}}]} with max_cells=4. In one clone set tables=[] and arrays={}; in another leave row_indices=[0] and slice both arrays to the first row. Both clones were accepted, equal_original=False, with unresolved null count fields. Exact executable command and stdout are preserved in reviewer_multiplicity_repro.log and embedded below.
Important.recommendation: In a single TDD fix pass, reject bundles whose metadata does not cover every encoder-recognized residual placeholder exactly once. Validate coverage across root/nested lists and both field names, including omitted whole tables, partial row lists, and zero-column empty mappings. Retain legitimate missing fields and unrelated null metadata.
Important.test_gap: Current malformed-bundle cases check referenced rows and arrays but never omitted table/row coverage.
